reply:
Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out, and great question! I completely understand the appeal of a dark mode for those late-night project-tracking sessions.

I don't have a specific release date to share right now, but dark mode is a frequently requested feature and our product team is aware of the interest. I've logged your request and added your vote to help prioritize it.

In the meantime, if you're using a browser, some extensions (like "Dark Reader") can apply a dark theme to Loopwise as a workaround until native support is available.

I'll make sure to follow up here if there's any update on the timeline. Thanks again for the feedback, it genuinely helps us shape the roadmap!

Best,
Loopwise Support
